query:
WITH specs AS (SELECT n.node_id,json_extract(n.properties_json,'$.specNumber') AS ts FROM _node_record n WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM json_each(n.labels_json) WHERE value='Spec')),
domain AS (SELECT DISTINCT ts FROM specs WHERE ts IN (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)),
crs AS (SELECT DISTINCT s.ts,n.node_id FROM _node_record n JOIN edge e ON e.src_id=n.node_id AND e.rel_type='MODIFIES' JOIN specs s ON s.node_id=e.dst_id WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM json_each(n.labels_json) WHERE value='CR')),
agrs AS (SELECT DISTINCT crs.ts,a.node_id FROM _node_record a JOIN edge e ON e.src_id=a.node_id AND e.rel_type='REFERENCES' JOIN crs ON crs.node_id=e.dst_id WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM json_each(a.labels_json) WHERE value='Agreement'))
SELECT ts,(SELECT count(*) FROM crs WHERE crs.ts=domain.ts) AS crCnt,(SELECT count(*) FROM agrs WHERE agrs.ts=domain.ts) AS agrCnt FROM domain ORDER BY crCnt DESC,ts ASC
access: ro immutable query_only; generic node/edge correlated identity-set aggregates
